title: Roof Replacement in Damascus, OR
summary: French Roofing did a full tear-off and roof replacement on a home in Damascus, OR that had years of patching and tarp repairs on it. The new roof has architectural shingles, clean flashing, and proper ventilation.
scope: Full tear-off of the old, patched roof

photos.alt: Worn roof with patched areas and a blue tarp in Damascus, OR, before French Roofing replaced it
photos.caption: Before: years of patching and a tarp

photos.alt: The same roof after French Roofing's replacement: new shingles, clean flashing and vents
photos.caption: After: new shingles, flashing and vents
